name: Hans
title: Five Areas, Five Challenges
blurb: Dad doesn't get off easy. I set goals in five areas of life - Spiritual, Social, Intellectual, Physical, and Personal Management - so I'm taking on a Beast Challenge in each one.

challenges.title: Old Testament Push
challenges.blurb: I started reading the Old Testament four years ago and I'm still working through it. The goal is to make real, measurable progress before the end of the year - details coming soon.
ideas: Finish a specific book (or set of books) by December 31
Read a set number of chapters (the Old Testament has 929)
Read every day for the rest of the year - a streak challenge
Reach a percentage of the whole Old Testament

challenges.title: CPA Study Hours
challenges.blurb: 60 hours of focused FAR study before December 31 - about 50 minutes a day, with room for the busy holiday weeks.

challenges.title: Pull-Up Partners
challenges.blurb: Training side by side with Fletcher: 6 unassisted pull-ups by the end of the year. I can do 1 today. The bands help me get the reps in while I build strength.

milestones.title: Orange Belt
milestones.desc: 8 reps on the orange band (or lighter).

milestones.title: Green Light
milestones.desc: 8 reps on the dark green band (or lighter).

milestones.title: Last Band Standing
milestones.desc: 8 reps on the light green band.

milestones.title: Super Six
milestones.desc: 6 unassisted pull-ups - matching Fletcher's goal. CHALLENGE COMPLETE!

challenges.title: 3-Mile Run
challenges.blurb: Run 3 miles in 30:00 or less (a 10:00 mile pace). The goal time is a placeholder until I log a first test run.

milestones.title: Halfway Faster
milestones.desc: Get halfway from your first time to the goal time.

milestones.title: Sub-30
milestones.desc: Run 3 miles in 30:00 or less. CHALLENGE COMPLETE!

challenges.title: Pay Off the Car
challenges.blurb: Paying off the car is one more step toward being debt free. To keep the dollar amounts private, this one tracks the percent of today's balance that's been paid off.

milestones.title: Title in Hand
milestones.desc: 100% paid off - the car is ours! CHALLENGE COMPLETE!

ideas: Social: monthly one-on-one date with each kid, all the way through December
Social: weekly date night every week until the deadline
Intellectual: memorize 100 digits of Pi (currently at 20)
